section_title: Vulnerable Witnesses and Special Evidence Procedures

nodes.label: Vulnerable Witnesses and Special Evidence Procedures
nodes.summary: Child witnesses, mentally incapacitated witnesses, sexual offence complainants, live link, anonymity.

nodes.label: Child Witnesses (Under 14)
nodes.summary: May give evidence unsworn if court considers child understands duty to tell truth (Cap 8 s.4). Special measures: live TV link, video recorded evidence-in-chief (Cap 221 ss.79B-79E). Available for offences involving assault, injury, threat; child or mentally incapacitated witness.

nodes.label: Evidence Ordinance (Cap 8) s.4
nodes.summary: Child witness unsworn evidence if understands duty to tell truth.

nodes.label: Criminal Procedure Ordinance (Cap 221) ss.79B-79E
nodes.summary: Special measures for vulnerable witnesses: live TV link, video-recorded evidence-in-chief.

nodes.label: Mentally Incapacitated Witnesses
nodes.summary: Same special measures as children under Cap 221 ss.79B-79E.

nodes.label: Complainants in Specified Sexual Offences
nodes.summary: Cap 221 s.79C: complainants of certain sexual offences automatically eligible for live TV link unless court orders otherwise. Video-recorded evidence-in-chief admissible (s.79D).

nodes.label: Criminal Procedure Ordinance (Cap 221) s.79C
nodes.summary: Complainants of certain sexual offences automatically eligible for live TV link.

nodes.label: Witnesses Outside Hong Kong
nodes.summary: Live television link under Cap 221 Part IIIB as above in trial section.

nodes.label: Witness Anonymity / In Camera Proceedings
nodes.summary: Court may permit witness to testify behind screen or under pseudonym if necessary to protect witness and interests of justice. Fairness safeguards: directions to jury to avoid prejudice.
